b1-unit-62.62.1 Gap Year Diaries: our bucket lists:
Danny: Welcome to Gap Year Diaries! Today's topic is bucket lists: the things you want to do before you... well, before you get too old. I'm here with Bruno and Rafa. Bruno, you go first.
Bruno: OK. Number one: I've always dreamed of running a marathon in another country. Maybe in Chicago, with Danny as my guide.
Danny: I'm sure you will! You run every morning anyway.
Bruno: Number two: I'd love to go up in a hot air balloon at sunrise.
Rafa: Oh, I wouldn't do that. I'm scared of heights.
Danny: Rafa, what's on your list?
Rafa: One of my dreams is to record an album with the band. Just ten songs, nothing big.
Bruno: That would be amazing! I can't wait to hear it.
Rafa: And I really hope I get to play at a jazz festival one day. Even at five in the afternoon, with nobody watching.
Danny: Go for it! We'll be in the front row.
Rafa: Your turn, Danny.
Danny: Well, the big one is the Amazon. I've been saving for months, and I'm determined to go before I leave Brazil. I'm dying to sleep in a hammock in the rainforest.
Bruno: Cool. But I think that might be too dangerous for me. Spiders!
Danny: Then, I wish I could cook like Mrs. Lima, but I don't think I have the talent.
Rafa: Don't let that stop you! Just ask her to teach you.
Danny: And the last one is a bit crazy. I want to learn to surf.
Bruno: Hmm, that's not really my thing. I can't even swim very well.
Danny: Well, those are our lists. What's on yours? Tell us in the comments!
